title: dmath: sin, cos, atan2, exp, log and pow that give the same bits everywhere

implements.text: Ports of the fdlibm kernels (FreeBSD msun) built on + - * /, sqrt, floor and abs, so every JavaScript engine returns the same Float64 bits

unsupported.text: Every other math function: tan, asin, acos, sinh and the rest use the built-in versions

parameterSources.note: licence: free to use, copy, modify and distribute with the notice kept

knownFailureCases: No test in the repository compares the results with fdlibm or across engines yet
